deck_plan.offense: Use Bash+ and Thunderclap+ to apply Vulnerable, then exploit it with Pommel Strikes, Iron Wave, Sword Boomerang, and other efficient attacks. Akabeko improves the first attack each turn. Continue removing Strikes rather than adding mediocre attacks.
deck_plan.defense: Use Defends, upgraded Defends, Iron Wave, Shrug It Off, Disarm+, Impervious, and Apparitions. Apparitions provide limited-use burst mitigation, while Disarm+ and Impervious help against dangerous physical attacks.
deck_plan.scaling: The deck still lacks reliable long-term scaling. Seek compact Strength or another efficient damage engine such as Inflame or Spot Weakness. Removing Strikes and Writhe will improve draw quality and effective damage.
deck_plan.draw_energy: Bag of Preparation, Battle Trance, and two Pommel Strikes provide adequate draw. Cursed Key supplies four energy, but Bash+ and both Impervious cards still create energy strain. Avoid additional expensive cards unless their impact is exceptional.
deck_plan.aoe: Thunderclap+ provides sufficient early AoE and Vulnerable. Additional AoE is unnecessary unless it also offers excellent single-target damage or meaningful scaling.
weaknesses: The 26-card deck is already larger than desired, with Writhe adding dilution
Reliable long-term damage scaling is missing
Several important cards cost two energy despite the four-energy ceiling
Defense relies partly on limited-use Apparitions
Current HP is low, so unnecessary fights and card dilution are especially costly
acquisition_priorities: Inflame, Spot Weakness, or another compact and reliable damage-scaling card
Remove basic Strikes and eventually Writhe
Take efficient attacks only if they substantially outperform Strike without worsening energy strain
Take compact defensive cards that improve consistency or exhaust cleanly
Upgrade important attacks and defensive cards
avoid: Warcry unless a specific exhaust or top-deck setup need emerges
Clash because the deck contains too many skills and Apparitions
Cards that add draw dilution without solving a major problem
Further deck dilution when the card does not materially advance offense, defense, scaling, or consistency

plan_change_reason: The existing deck already has a coherent Vulnerable-based offense and strong but limited defensive tools; none of the offered cards solves the central scaling problem well enough to justify increasing the already-large deck.
